category_title: Disengaged students with off-task behaviors and social distractions
scenario_title: Small group science assignments and whole-class instruction
minimal_context: The student is working in a small group using an iPad to complete a science assignment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please work with your small group to complete the science assignment on your iPads.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns away from the assignment to talk to a peer) I'm just trying to understand what was going on with that thing earlier.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's do a quick check for understanding on the science material. Wiggle your fingers if you know what to do next.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shows a thumbs-down and does not wiggle their fingers)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, just keep trying to figure it out with your group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Opens a game on the iPad and looks over to copy off a friend's screen) If I can’t ‘Google’ the answer then I just don’t do it. I try to remember. I usually just wait for the answer.

task.content: Working in small groups to complete science assignments and participating in informal checks for understanding during whole-class instruction

context.environment: Classroom during science instruction and independent/group work
context.social_setting: Working in small groups and interacting with peers

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When it came to understanding the science material or encountering difficulty
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Copied off of peers to complete assignments, played a game on the iPad, talked to other students during instruction, or just stared off during class
related_quotes: I try to remember. I usually just wait for the answer.
If I can’t ‘Google’ the answer then I just don’t do it.

behavior_patterns.condition: When teachers gave direction for informal checks for understanding
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Students showed thumbs-down or did not wiggle their finger
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Indicated their lack of knowledge and communicated uncertainty

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Engaging in off-topic conversations and socializing with peers, which served as a distraction from their learning
